name: rare-error-onset-replicaset-attribution
description: Find which deploy change made a rare per-pod error start, or become more frequent, on Kubernetes: compute the error's rate per ReplicaSet against an exposure count (scrapes, requests), then diff the ReplicaSet pod templates. Use when: (1) a rare WARN or exception "came up recently" and the new image is the default suspect; (2) Prometheus `up=0` / failed scrapes must be split into pod startup/shutdown noise and steady-state failures; (3) you have a handful of events and must judge whether a before/after difference is real.
